veranderings.rede: After 'Wie ... opgepas het', 'hulle melk' can be misread as the caretakers' own milk; 'die melk' points clearly to the cattle's milk.

veranderings.voor: kon van hulle aan so 'n nuweling
veranderings.na: kon van sy beeste aan so 'n nuweling
veranderings.rede: The bare partitive 'van hulle' reads loosely; naming the owner's cattle makes clear what is lent and whose they are.
